### Step 2: Script Auto-Claim 8 Base (ServerScriptService)
📌 **Bikin Script biasa di:** `ServerScriptService` -> Namain `PlotManager`

Script ini tugasnya:
* Pas player join, otomatis dicarikan Base yang masih kosong (Base 1 - 8).
* Papan nama base otomatis berubah jadi: `Base Milik: [Nama Player]`.
* Pas player mati, respawn-nya langsung di basenya sendiri.
* Pas player keluar game (leave), basenya otomatis kosong lagi buat player baru.

```lua
-- Script: ServerScriptService > PlotManager
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local plotsFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("Plots")

-- Tabel buat nyatet siapa megang base apa
local occupiedPlots = {}

-- Fungsi pas player join
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local assignedPlot = nil

	-- Cari base yang kosong dari Base1 sampe Base8
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local plot = plotsFolder:FindFirstChild("Base" .. i)
		if plot and not occupiedPlots[plot] then
			assignedPlot = plot
			occupiedPlots[plot] = player
			break
		end
	end

	if assignedPlot then
		print(player.Name .. " dapet " .. assignedPlot.Name)

		-- Ubah teks di Papan Nama Base
		local sign = assignedPlot:FindFirstChild("Sign")
		if sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") then
			local label = sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
			if label then
				label.Text = "Base Milik: " .. player.DisplayName
				label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 127) -- Warna hijau
			end
		end

		-- Bikin player spawn di dalem basenya sendiri
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local spawnPart = assignedPlot:FindFirstChild("SpawnPoint")
			if spawnPart then
				task.wait(0.1)
				root.CFrame = spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end)
	else
		warn("Server penuh, gak ada base kosong buat " .. player.Name)
	end
end

-- Fungsi pas player keluar (Leave)
local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	for plot, owner in pairs(occupiedPlots) do
		if owner == player then
			occupiedPlots[plot] = nil
			print(plot.Name .. " sekarang kosong lagi!")

			-- Reset teks papan nama
			local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("Sign")
			if sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") then
				local label = sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
				if label then
					label.Text = plot.Name .. " (Kosong)"
					label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				end
			end
			break
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
```
